verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a setting to disable GlitchTip's own telemetry or usage tracking. The tracesSampleRate option controls how much performance data a user's app sends to GlitchTip, not tracking of the user. Self-hosting, EU residency and the MCP server's 'no data sharing' claim are adjacent privacy features, not a telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
